app_fee.value: Standard Graduate Studies application fee is $60 USD non-refundable ($0 for IGPBS PhD programs).
app_fee.quote: $60 Application Fee: The fee is non-refundable | $0-IGPBS Application Fee: Refer to section below the Interdisciplinary Graduate Program in Biomedical Sciences Application for more information.

fee_waiver.value: No general Graduate Studies application fee waiver policy is stated outside IGPBS (which charges $0 to all applicants).

gre_general.value: GRE General requirements vary by program (not required for IGPBS PhD programs).

also.quote: The GRE may be required for admission to certain programs.

toefl_min.value: Graduate Studies minimum is 85 on TOEFL iBT (4.5 band score on the new 1–6 scale); IGPBS PhD programs require 95 overall (20 minimum per section; 5.0 new scale).
toefl_min.quote: For the TOEFL, a score of at least 85 on the old internet-based exam or a minimum band score of 4.5 on the new internet-based exam is required. ... Some graduate programs may require higher minimum scores.

ielts_min.value: Graduate Studies minimum is IELTS Academic 6.5 overall; IGPBS PhD programs require 7.0 overall.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum acceptable IELTS band score is 6.5. ... Some graduate programs may require higher minimum scores.

english_waiver.value: India is not exempt, and English as the language of instruction at a foreign university does not qualify for a waiver unless you studied at a U.S. university (1+ academic year) or in a country where English is the only official language.
english_waiver.quote: You may be exempt from the English proficiency requirement if you have been studying at a university inside the U.S. for at least one academic year or attending a university in a country where the only official language is English, such as U.K., Australia or Canada (excluding Quebec). ... Evaluation for a waiver of the English language proficiency exam is not determined by the prevalence of spoken English in a country or the language of instruction at a university.

notes: Health-science campus (Omaha, NE): research covers biomed and neuro (both via IGPBS); UNMC does not offer standalone PhDs in biomedical engineering or biology.
